report: S23 日夜标注独立检查
scope: current generated HTML and embedded candidates

findings.title: No-ballot and incomplete-ballot days are reported as determinate effective faction vote counts

reproduction.phase_findings: No vote_control finding is emitted for either day.

code.detail: vote_totals derives values from counts of living faction seats and adds the badge half-vote; it does not consume recorded ballot votes or abstentions.
The day loop calls vote_totals even when no initial exile ballot exists. It only adds a finding when controls_vote is null, so no-ballot days get a determinate result.
The UI labels these roster counts as votes and states whether the bind-vote condition is met.

findings.recommendation: For actual effective exile-vote counts, tally complete recorded initial ballot votes by each voter's victory faction, exclude abstentions, and add the sheriff half-vote only when the badge-holder cast a valid vote. If a ballot is absent or partial, leave actual counts and controls_vote unresolved (or clearly label a separate hypothetical living-voting-power calculation). A self-destruct-interrupted day with no ballot must not be presented as an actual vote tally.

verified.check: First-game correction and user-confirmed wolf-mixed arithmetic
verified.details: Generated candidate has first-day night_deaths die targets [2,5], hunter_state cannot_shoot for seat 5, and day-one vote_control 5.5 to 5 with controls_vote=true.
Current browser check sees 投票者 and 投向 only; no 票重 or 依据 column.

verified.check: Phase anchors and active critical unknown coverage
verified.details: A Playwright injection places an unresolved first-night finding under the 开局夜晚 anchor. Across the current 75-game embedded candidate, active unknown critical events were phase-anchored; the four unanchored unknowns observed were in post-terminal placeholder phases. This is a candidate-data cross-check, not an exhaustive source-video review of every inferred unavailable state.

verified.check: No later daytime rendered for terminal-night cases in current candidate
verified.details: The current snapshot contains no phase finding after a terminal night; the renderer only adds a day section when there is a displayed day phase or a day finding. No fabricated later daytime was observed.
6 tests passed. Existing tests exercise vote_totals on constructed living rosters, but not absent/partial ballots or abstentions.
Playwright returned passed=true with no failures.

coverage_boundaries: Read-only audit of the current scripts, embedded candidate snapshot, and existing test/browser checks; no season-wide video rewatch was performed.

The user-confirmed rule text says effective exile-vote counts; current ballots inspected in mixed-blood games were complete when present, but several days had no ballot. The defect is that those absent-ballot days still receive roster-derived determinate vote totals.
No shared script, candidate, or configuration file was edited.
